author: Epictetus
text: The former things are not in our control, the latter are. If you have the right idea about what is yours and what is not, you will never be under compulsion.

author: Epictetus
text: Make a practice of saying to every harsh appearance: 'You are an appearance, and in no manner what you appear to be.'

author: Epictetus
text: Don't hope that events will turn out the way you want, welcome events in whichever way they happen: this is the path to peace.

author: Epictetus
text: It is not events that disturb people, it is their judgements concerning them.

author: Epictetus
text: You have to know what you want to be. Then do what you have to do.

author: Marcus Aurelius
text: You have power over your mind - not outside events. Realize this, and you will find strength.

author: Marcus Aurelius
text: Waste no more time arguing about what a good man should be. Be one.

author: Marcus Aurelius
text: The best revenge is to be unlike him who performed the injury.

author: Naval
text: Wealth is the ability to do what you want, when you want, with who you want, and how you want.

author: Naval
text: Seek wealth, not money or status. Wealth is having assets that earn while you sleep.

author: Robert Greene
text: Always make those above you feel comfortably superior.

author: Robert Greene
text: Win through your actions, never through argument.

author: Florence Scovel Shinn
text: The decks are now cleared for Divine Action and my own comes to me under grace in a magical way.

author: Florence Scovel Shinn
text: I now let go of worn-out conditions and worn-out things. Divine order is established in my mind, body and affairs.

author: Florence Scovel Shinn
text: My seeming impossible good now comes to pass, the unexpected now happens!

author: Florence Scovel Shinn
text: The 'four winds of success' now blow to me my own. From North, South, East and West comes my endless good.

author: Florence Scovel Shinn
text: I give thanks for my whirlwind success. I sweep all before me for I work with the Spirit and follow the Divine Plan of my life.

author: Florence Scovel Shinn
text: I am awake to my good, and gather in the harvest of endless opportunities.

author: Florence Scovel Shinn
text: I am harmonious, poised and magnetic. I now draw to myself my own. My power is God's power and is irresistible!

author: Florence Scovel Shinn
text: Divine Order is now established in my mind, body and affairs. I see clearly and act quickly and my greatest expectations come to pass in a miraculous way.

author: Florence Scovel Shinn
text: There is no competition on the spiritual plane. What is rightfully mine is given me under grace.

author: Florence Scovel Shinn
text: I have a magical work in a magical way, I give magical service for magical pay.

author: Florence Scovel Shinn
text: Jehovah goes before me and the battle is won! All enemy thoughts are wiped out.

author: Florence Scovel Shinn
text: There are no obstacles in Divine Mind, therefore, there is nothing to obstruct my good.

author: Florence Scovel Shinn
text: I banish the past. There are no lost opportunities in the Kingdom. As one door shuts another door opens.

author: Florence Scovel Shinn
text: God's plan for me is permanent and cannot be budged. I am true to my heavenly vision.

author: Florence Scovel Shinn
text: I do not resist this situation. I put it in the hands of Infinite Love and Wisdom. Let the Divine idea now come to pass.

author: Florence Scovel Shinn
text: There is nothing to fear for there is no power to hurt. I walk up to the lion on my pathway and find an angel in armor.

author: Florence Scovel Shinn
text: God cannot fail, so I cannot fail. 'The warrior within me' has already won.

author: Jeremy Miner
text: Questions don’t just gather facts—they build value.

author: Jeremy Miner
text: People don’t resist solutions; they resist pressure.

author: Jeremy Miner
text: Don’t pitch first—diagnose first.

author: Jeremy Miner
text: Emotion is the gateway—logic is the receipt.

author: Jeremy Miner
text: Surface pain is what they say; root pain is what they feel.

author: Jeremy Miner
text: Your job is to reveal truth, not win arguments.

author: Jeremy Miner
text: Stop talking when they start thinking.

author: Chris Voss
text: Win their trust first; terms come later.

author: Chris Voss
text: Mirroring isn’t repeating—it’s inviting them to keep going.

author: Chris Voss
text: Don’t fight for ‘yes’; earn a genuine ‘that’s right’.

author: Chris Voss
text: Make ‘no’ safe—people relax when they can say it.

author: Chris Voss
text: Tactical empathy: understand without agreeing.

author: Chris Voss
text: Your job isn’t to be right; it’s to be understood.

author: Jordan Belfort
text: Your first four seconds decide your next forty minutes.

author: Jordan Belfort
text: Tonality is the delivery system for certainty.

author: Jordan Belfort
text: If you don’t believe it, they won’t buy it.

author: Jordan Belfort
text: Fear makes you talk; skill makes you ask.

author: Jordan Belfort
text: People buy the certainty behind the words.

author: Brian Tracy
text: Your income grows when your value grows.

author: Brian Tracy
text: Prospects buy feelings first and features second.

author: Brian Tracy
text: Trust is the invisible discount.

author: Brian Tracy
text: Enthusiasm without competence is noise.

author: Brian Tracy
text: Great salespeople ask, then shut up.

author: Execution OS
text: Discipline is just love with a schedule.

author: Execution OS
text: If it’s not written, it’s not real.

author: Execution OS
text: You don’t need motivation. You need a protocol.

author: Execution OS
text: Build the ritual, then let the ritual build you.

author: Execution OS
text: Consistency beats intensity when life gets loud.

author: Execution OS
text: Systems don’t care how you feel. That’s why they win.

author: Execution OS
text: Momentum is a decision you keep making.

author: Execution OS
text: Your environment is a silent cofounder.

author: Execution OS
text: If you want a new life, change your defaults.

author: Execution OS
text: Mastery is boredom conquered.

author: Innervation Atlas
text: Posture is a mood you can train.

author: Innervation Atlas
text: Where you can’t feel, you can’t steer.

author: Innervation Atlas
text: Tension is information, not punishment.

author: Breathwork Toolkit
text: Slow breath, wide mind.

author: Breathwork Toolkit
text: Anxiety is often just speed without direction.

author: Breathwork Toolkit
text: Oxygen fuels. Rhythm regulates.

author: Thoth
text: Your light is visible even through the veil of darkness.

author: Thoth
text: Seek wisdom like oxygen, not like decoration.

author: Thoth
text: Freedom begins where the 'fetter' ends.

author: Thoth
text: Wisdom outlives every era because it was older than the era.

author: Thoth
text: You don’t need new worlds; you need the key within you.

author: Thoth
text: The soul is what’s space-free; everything else is rented.

author: Thoth
text: As above, so below; but remember to look above first.

author: Manly P. Hall
text: Courage is a prerequisite to knowledge.

author: Manly P. Hall
text: The 'key of wisdom' is found where fear says don’t look.

author: Manly P. Hall
text: Mastery isn’t domination—it’s spiritual strength taming the animal world.

author: Manly P. Hall
text: To reach philosophy, invert the order of your life.

author: Manly P. Hall
text: Symbol is a bridge when vocabulary is too small.

author: Manly P. Hall
text: A mind that refuses mystery becomes brittle.

author: Manly P. Hall
text: Great learning is a marriage of intellect and intense feeling.

author: Practical Occultism
text: Wisdom can be perverted by ignorance or by selfishness.

author: Practical Occultism
text: A healthy spirituality should not need moonshine.

author: Practical Occultism
text: If it can’t earn the respect of thoughtful minds, refine it.

author: Practical Occultism
text: Real reform is purification, not decoration.

author: Practical Occultism
text: The most powerful magic is honest thinking.

author: KnockMaster AI
text: Remove sales pressure and your close rate climbs.

author: KnockMaster AI
text: Show-rate is built at the door, not on the phone.

author: KnockMaster AI
text: Pain grows when it’s specific to their bill, not generic.

author: LGCY Handbook
text: Massive action beats sophisticated procrastination.

author: LGCY Handbook
text: Break preoccupation first; everything else is wasted.

author: LGCY Handbook
text: Work the funnel: doors → conversations → appointments → deals.

author: Robert Greene
text: Always make those above you feel comfortably superior. In your desire to please or impress them, do not go too far in displaying your talents or you might accomplish the opposite—inspire fear and insecurity.
title: NEVER OUTSHINE THE MASTER

author: Robert Greene
text: Be wary of friends—they will betray you more quickly, for they are easily aroused to envy. They also become spoiled and tyrannical. But hire a former enemy and he will be more loyal than a friend.
title: NEVER PUT TOO MUCH TRUST IN FRIENDS

author: Robert Greene
text: Keep people off-balance and in the dark by never revealing the purpose behind your actions. If they have no clue what you are up to, they cannot prepare a defense.
title: CONCEAL YOUR INTENTIONS

author: Robert Greene
text: When you are trying to impress people with words, the more you say, the more common you appear, and the less in control. Powerful people impress and intimidate by saying less.
title: ALWAYS SAY LESS THAN NECESSARY

author: Robert Greene
text: Reputation is the cornerstone of power. Through reputation alone you can intimidate and win; once it slips, however, you are vulnerable, and will be attacked on all sides.
title: SO MUCH DEPENDS ON REPUTATION

author: Robert Greene
text: Everything is judged by its appearance; what is unseen counts for nothing. Never let yourself get lost in the crowd, then, or buried in oblivion. Stand out. Be conspicuous, at all cost.
title: COURT ATTENTION AT ALL COST

author: Robert Greene
text: Use the wisdom, knowledge, and legwork of other people to further your own cause. In the end your helpers will be forgotten and you will be remembered.
title: GET OTHERS TO DO THE WORK

author: Robert Greene
text: When you force the other person to act, you are the one in control. It is always better to make your opponent come to you, abandoning his own plans in the process.
title: MAKE OTHER PEOPLE COME TO YOU

author: Robert Greene
text: Any momentary triumph you think gained through argument is really a Pyrrhic victory. It is much more powerful to get others to agree with you through your actions, without saying a word.
title: WIN THROUGH ACTIONS, NEVER ARGUMENT

author: Robert Greene
text: You can die from someone else’s misery—emotional states are as infectious as disease. The unfortunate sometimes draw misfortune on themselves; they will also draw it on you.
title: INFECTION: AVOID THE UNHAPPY

author: Robert Greene
text: All great leaders since Moses have known that a feared enemy must be crushed completely. If one ember is left alight, a fire will eventually break out.
title: CRUSH YOUR ENEMY TOTALLY

author: Robert Greene
text: If you are unsure of a course of action, do not attempt it. Your doubts and hesitations will infect your execution. Timidity is dangerous: Better to enter with boldness.
title: ENTER ACTION WITH BOLDNESS

author: Robert Greene
text: By taking a shape, by having a visible plan, you open yourself to attack. The best way to protect yourself is to be as fluid and formless as water.
title: ASSUME FORMLESSNESS

author: Robert Greene
text: Life is a battle and you must define your enemies. Do not be naive; you need enemies to keep you sharp. A defined enemy gives you a sense of purpose and direction.
title: DECLARE WAR ON YOUR ENEMIES

author: Robert Greene
text: What worked yesterday will not necessarily work today. Do not let past successes make you rigid. Wage a guerrilla war on your own mind, allowing no static lines of defense.
title: DO NOT FIGHT THE LAST WAR

author: Robert Greene
text: In the heat of battle, the mind tends to lose its balance. You need the 'detached' mental power to keep your head when others are losing theirs.
title: AMIDST THE TURMOIL OF EVENTS, DO NOT LOSE YOUR PRESENCE OF MIND

author: Robert Greene
text: Place yourself on 'death ground' where your back is against the wall and you have to fight like hell to get out alive. Necessity rules the world.
title: CREATE A SENSE OF URGENCY AND DESPERATION

author: Robert Greene
text: Decentralize your army. Mobility and speed are critical. Structure your organization so it can move and adapt quickly to changing circumstances.
title: SEGMENT YOUR FORCES

author: Robert Greene
text: The best way to fight off aggressors is to keep them from attacking you in the first place. Build a reputation that is a little crazy and unpredictable.
title: CREATE A THREATENING PRESENCE

author: Robert Greene
text: Terrorism strategy: Create chaos and panic to provoke an overreaction. Use the smallest possible force to create the greatest possible disproportionate reaction.
title: CHAIN REACTION

author: Robert Greene
text: Offers total release from rational life; lures men through heightened sexual allure and theatrical presence. Embodies his fantasy to gain control of his libido.
title: The Siren

author: Robert Greene
text: Unrestrained and devoted purely to women, creating an unforgettable moment of pure pleasure and danger. Seduces women with words and infectious desire.
title: The Rake

author: Robert Greene
text: Reflects a target's crushed youth ideals or missing spiritual communion. Creates an illusion of romance and aesthetic perfection to win devotion.
title: The Ideal Lover

author: Robert Greene
text: Cannot be categorized, playing with masculine and feminine traits. Excites the trapped individual by hinting at a freedom and allure they crave for themselves.
title: The Dandy

author: Robert Greene
text: Embodies the longed-for qualities of childhood—spontaneity, sincerity, and playfulness. Neutralizes defensiveness by transporting the victim back to a golden age.
title: The Natural

author: Robert Greene
text: Masters the alternating movement between hope and frustration. Their self-sufficiency and cool distance make victims pursue them feverishly to secure a reward.
title: The Coquette

author: Robert Greene
text: Mask their manipulation by focusing attention entirely on the target, adapting to moods, and valuing self-esteem. They create pleasure and comfort to induce dependence.
title: The Charmer

author: Robert Greene
text: Excites the masses by radiating self-confidence, purpose, and mystery. They create a spiritual illusion, making themselves seem extraordinary and worthy of blind faith.
title: The Charismatic

author: Robert Greene
text: Feeds the universal need for escape and fantasy. They stand out through distinctive style, remaining vague and ethereal, allowing targets to imagine more than is there.
title: The Star

author: Robert Greene
text: The opposite of the seducer: insecure, self-absorbed, and oblivious to others' psychology. They repel targets through nagging, pestering, and total lack of subtlety.
title: The Anti-Seducer

author: Robert Greene
text: Choose targets who are isolated, unhappy, or have a void you can fill. Avoid the completely contented. The perfect victim makes the chase easier.
title: Choose the Right Victim

author: Robert Greene
text: Start at an angle, perhaps as a friend, to avoid arousing resistance. Lull the target into security before they even realize a seduction is happening.
title: Approach Indirectly

author: Robert Greene
text: Be hard to figure out by combining contradictory qualities (e.g., tough yet tender, innocent yet cunning). A mix suggests depth and complexity that fascinates.
title: Send Mixed Signals

author: Robert Greene
text: Surround yourself with admirers to create an aura of desirability. Stimulate rivalry so the target's vanity makes them desperate to possess you.
title: Create Triangles

author: Robert Greene
text: Instill dissatisfaction with the target's current circumstances or self-image. Pain and anxiety precede pleasure; manufacture the void you alone can fill.
title: Create a Need

author: Robert Greene
text: Plant ideas in the victim's mind using elusive hints and ambiguous gestures. Your suggestive sublanguage bypasses defenses and makes the idea seem like their own.
title: Master Insinuation

author: Robert Greene
text: Adapt to their moods, enjoy what they enjoy, and play by their rules to stroke their narcissism. This lowers defenses and makes them open to your subtle influence.
title: Enter Their Spirit

author: Robert Greene
text: Awaken irresistible desire by hinting that you can fulfill a secret, repressed fantasy. Keep the promise vague to stimulate curiosity and postpone satisfaction.
title: Create Temptation

author: Robert Greene
text: Break the predictability by delivering a calculated surprise or sudden change of direction. This keeps the victim off balance, creating a delightful sense of spontaneity.
title: Keep in Suspense

author: Robert Greene
text: Fill their ears with sweet flattery and vague promises. Seductive language intoxicates emotions and weakens resistance by appealing to illusion over reality.
title: Use Demonic Words

author: Robert Greene
text: Use subtle gestures, tailored gifts, and pleasing rituals to distract the senses. Mesmerized by small, charming details, they won't notice your true objective.
title: Pay Attention to Detail

author: Robert Greene
text: Alternate exciting presence with cool distance and absence. Associate yourself with poetic images so the target idealizes you in your absence and resists familiarity.
title: Poeticize Your Presence

author: Robert Greene
text: Make the target feel superior and strong by seeming vulnerable, emotional, or bashful. Play the victim to cover your calculated tracks and turn sympathy into love.
title: Disarm via Weakness

author: Robert Greene
text: Create the illusion that through you they can live out their deepest, thwarted dreams. Aim at secret wishes to stir uncontrollable emotions and cloud their reason.
title: Confuse Reality

author: Robert Greene
text: You are not born rational; you must cultivate this power. Emotions dominate your decisions, forcing you to seek comforting ideas and skewing your view of reality.
title: Master Your Emotional Self

author: Robert Greene
text: We are all narcissists to some degree. Turn your natural self-love outward to genuinely understand others' perspectives, rather than letting self-absorption isolate and blind you.
title: Transform Self-love into Empathy

author: Robert Greene
text: People constantly wear masks to present a positive front. Master nonverbal cues (the "second language") to read the true feelings and concealed aggression leaking from beneath their facade.
title: See Through People’s Masks

author: Robert Greene
text: Character is destiny. Ignore reputation and charm; study long-term patterns, as deep-seated habits compel people to inevitably repeat their behavior and mistakes. People never do something just once.
title: Determine the Strength of People’s Character

author: Robert Greene
text: People desire what they cannot easily possess (the "grass-is-always-greener" syndrome). Create an aura of mystery and strategic absence to make yourself an object of consuming fantasy and longing.
title: Become an Elusive Object of Desire

author: Robert Greene
text: Avoid the trap of living only in the moment. Cultivate a farsighted view, looking for consequences and long-term trends to avoid irrational, reactive decisions.
title: Elevate Your Perspective

author: Robert Greene
text: People need to feel smart, autonomous, and good. Validate these needs to lower their defenses, then gently guide them. Never attack their self-image directly.
title: Soften People’s Resistance by Confirming Their Self-opinion

author: Robert Greene
text: Your attitude shapes your reality. A defensive or fearful attitude creates negative interactions; an expansive, fearless attitude creates opportunities and draws people to you.
title: Change Your Circumstances by Changing Your Attitude

author: Robert Greene
text: We all have a Shadow—repressed desires and aggression. Integrate this dark energy into your personality to become whole, authentic, and creatively powerful, rather than projecting it onto others.
title: Confront Your Dark Side

author: Robert Greene
text: Envy is a pervasive, destructive emotion rooted in insecurity. Detect the signs of silent envy in others, and deflect it by downplaying your success. Use your own envy as a spur to achievement.
title: Beware the Fragile Ego

author: Robert Greene
text: Grandiosity is an unrealistic sense of your own power. Tie your confidence to reality and actual achievements. Success can be dangerous if it makes you lose touch with your limits.
title: Know Your Limits

author: Robert Greene
text: Rigid gender roles limit your power. Embrace your anima (feminine side) or animus (masculine side) to become more balanced, empathetic, and flexible in your thinking and behavior.
title: Reconnect to the Masculine or Feminine Within You

author: Robert Greene
text: Aimlessness makes you vulnerable to chaos. Develop a high sense of purpose—a mission that fits your nature—to give your life unbreakable force and direction. This is a powerful "force multiplier".
title: Advance with a Sense of Purpose

author: Robert Greene
text: Groups naturally degrade individual rationality and encourage conformity (the "social force"). Cultivate detachment to maintain your independence, and strategically use self-awareness to positively guide the group dynamic.
title: Resist the Downward Pull of the Group

author: Robert Greene
text: Authority must be earned; people are ambivalent about leaders and quick to turn. Demonstrate high purpose and empathy while maintaining a firm vision. Never assume loyalty or display arrogance, which invites rebellion.
title: Make Them Want to Follow You

author: Robert Greene
text: Aggression is rooted in fear and the need for control. Recognize "sophisticated aggressors" by their compulsion to dominate and the rationalizations they use. Channel your own assertive energy productively (controlled aggression).
title: See the Hostility Behind the Friendly Facade

author: Robert Greene
text: Generational attitudes create cultural shifts and blindness. Understand the current Zeitgeist—the collective spirit and trends—to free your mind from its constraints and strategically position your work to set new directions.
title: Seize the Historical Moment

author: Robert Greene
text: Denying death creates chronic anxiety and denial of reality. Confront your mortality to gain urgency, clarity, and an intense sense of purpose. This paradoxically makes you feel more alive and resilient.
title: Meditate on Our Common Mortality
